description: Coroutine performance benchmark - 10K create, 100K yield, 1K sleep
proves: TLL coroutine creation is performant (~95us each)
TLL coroutine yield/resume is fast (~2.2us each)
TLL sleep coroutine overhead is low (~0.1ms each)
does_not_prove: 100K concurrent ACTIVE coroutines (test uses immediate-return, not concurrent active)
Memory efficiency (RSS not measured in this benchmark)
note: Benchmarks are recorded but not yet enforced as hard gates (no performance regression detection in CI). Future phase will add performance regression detection.
provenance_chain: CI Run #123 verified test passes (but does not enforce performance thresholds)
